acroyali.about:
Acroyali is the brand of Acroyali Holdings (Qingdao) Co., Ltd., a food manufacturer in Shandong Province, China. Its range covers canned fruit and vegetables, pulses, fruit fillings and toppings for food service and retail.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Acroyali in Sri Lanka, supplying hotels, restaurants, bakeries and retailers island-wide from Colombo. The range includes fruit pie fillings in apple, blueberry, raspberry, red cherry and strawberry, each in a 50% and a 70% version; peach halves, pear halves in syrup, lychees, fruit cocktail and pitted dark sweet cherries; red glacé cherries for baking; sweet corn kernels, cream-style sweet corn, young corn, straw mushrooms and whole mushrooms; and baked beans and red kidney beans.
acroyali.summary: Canned fruit, fruit pie fillings, vegetables and pulses made by Acroyali Holdings (Qingdao) in China.
acroyali.replaces: We are committed to producing and delivering a diverse range of premium canned foods that cater to the evolving tastes, lifestyles, and needs of our customers.

albertos.about:
Albertos (also sold as Alberto's) is a range of soft flour tortilla wraps.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Albertos tortillas in Sri Lanka in two sizes: 10-inch wraps in packs of six, for burritos, large wraps and quesadillas, and 6-inch wraps in packs of eight, for tacos, fajitas and smaller servings. Restaurants, cafés, hotels and caterers buy them for Mexican and wrap menus, alongside Tabasco pepper sauce.
albertos.summary: Soft flour tortilla wraps in 10-inch and 6-inch sizes for burritos, wraps, quesadillas and tacos.
albertos.replaces: lberto's Tortilla Wraps are a brand of, often, frozen or packaged flour tortillas known for being soft and easy to roll, commonly available in sizes like 10-inch and 6-inch. The product, often associated with, or manufactured by, "Senor Pepe" or similar Middle East-based food companies, is frequently used for wraps and in food service.

azizaa.about:
Azizaa is a basmati rice brand from India. Basmati is an aromatic long-grain rice used for biryani, pilaf and other dishes where the grains should cook up separate.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Azizaa in Sri Lanka in four lines: Basmati Rice in 5 kg and 20 kg bags, Extra Long Grain Basmati Rice Gold, and Extra Long Grain Basmati Rice Platinum 1121. Hotels, restaurants and caterers buy it for biryani, fried rice, pilaf and buffet service.
azizaa.summary: Basmati rice from India in 5 kg and 20 kg bags, with extra-long-grain Gold and Platinum 1121 lines.
azizaa.replaces: Azizaa Basmati Rice is a variant of Basmati Rice, grown in the foot of The Himalayas, is success story of Modern Science in delivering the long slender translucent grain, which elongates on cooking without increase in its breadth.

daily-dairy.about:
Daily Dairy is the brand of Daily Dairy Holland, a cheese supplier in the Netherlands. Its range covers Dutch classics such as Gouda and Edam, cheeses from other European traditions, and V.S.O.C., its range of aged cheese.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Daily Dairy cheese in Sri Lanka for hotels, restaurants, cafés and retailers: Gouda, Edam, white and coloured Cheddar, Emmental, Comté, Grana Padano, Pecorino Romano, young goat cheese, Snow White Danish blue and V.S.O.C Black Label aged Gouda.
daily-dairy.summary: Dutch and European cheeses from Daily Dairy Holland, from Gouda and Edam to V.S.O.C aged Gouda.
daily-dairy.replaces: We supply a complete range of the best Dutch, European, and special flavoured cheeses in more than 80 countries.

damaco.about:
Damaco is a food brand of the Damaco Group, a Belgian producer and exporter of food for professional kitchens and the food industry.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Damaco frozen vegetables in Sri Lanka and keeps them in its cold chain at −18 °C from the Colombo warehouse to the customer: broccoli, cauliflower, Brussels sprouts, green peas and a three-way mixed vegetable. Hotels, restaurants and caterers use them for stir-fries, fried rice, soups and side dishes.
damaco.summary: Frozen vegetables from the Damaco brand of Belgium's Damaco Group: broccoli, cauliflower, Brussels sprouts, peas and mixed vegetables.
damaco.replaces: Damaco Group is specialized in the production & export for the food & feed industry. We offer meat, potato products, vegetables, convenience & fish.

dedicato.about:
Dedicato is a pasta line from Granoro (Pastificio Attilio Mastromauro), the pasta maker in Corato, in Italy's Puglia region. Granoro describes the line as a regional supply chain built on durum wheat grown in Puglia, linking local farms, mills and its pasta factory.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Dedicato pasta in Sri Lanka for restaurants, hotels and retailers, including cannelloni for baking, pappardelle, spinach tagliatelle, spaghetti vermicelli and spirali fantasia.
dedicato.summary: Granoro's Dedicato pasta from Corato, Puglia, made with durum wheat grown in the region.
dedicato.replaces: 100% Puglia line, “Dedicated to our land”, which also includes the Whole Wheat, Egg, Specialties, and Premium Specialties lines.

dira.about:
DIRA is the frozen fruit brand of Dirafrost, a fruit processor in Belgium founded in 1988 and part of the AGRANA group. Dirafrost makes individually quick-frozen (IQF) fruit and fruit purees for food service, pastry and the food industry.

Olive Foods imports and distributes DIRA in Sri Lanka and delivers it frozen through its cold chain: purees in mango, passion fruit, strawberry, raspberry, lemon and coconut, and frozen blueberries, raspberries, cranberries, blackcurrants and red currants. Pastry kitchens, bars, cafés and hotels use them for mousses, sorbets, cocktails, smoothies, sauces and baking.
dira.summary: Frozen fruit and fruit purees from Dirafrost in Belgium, for pastry kitchens, bars, cafés and hotels.
dira.replaces: We offer a broad range of IQF fruit, purees, coulis, smoothie fruit and bakery specialties under our DIRA-brand or private label.

donna-chiara.about:
Donna Chiara is a range of dried pasta in classic Italian shapes.

Olive Foods imports and distributes six Donna Chiara shapes in Sri Lanka: spaghetti and linguine for long-pasta dishes, penne and fusilli for thick sauces and baked pasta, farfalloni (large bow-ties) for pasta salads and bakes, and mezzi gomiti elbow macaroni for macaroni and cheese. Restaurants, hotels, cafés and retailers buy it for everyday pasta service.
donna-chiara.summary: Dried pasta in six classic Italian shapes: spaghetti, linguine, penne, fusilli, farfalloni and elbow macaroni.
donna-chiara.replaces: Donna Chiara's Capellini, often referred to as angel hair pasta, boasts a tender and delicate texture that dances on the palate

hungritos.about:
Hungritos is a ready-to-cook frozen food brand of Iscon Balaji Foods Private Limited, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Its range covers frozen potato products and snacks.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Hungritos frozen potato products in Sri Lanka and stores and delivers them at −18 °C: 9 mm French fries, coated 7 mm shoestring fries, potato wedges and hash browns. Restaurants, quick-service outlets, hotels and caterers use them for burgers, sides, starters and breakfast service.
hungritos.summary: Frozen fries, wedges and hash browns from Iscon Balaji Foods in Ahmedabad, India.
hungritos.replaces: Hungritos is a premium ready-to-cook brand bringing to your table finger food which have been loved across generations.

mae-ploy.about:
Mae Ploy is a Thai brand of curry pastes and sauces, made in Thailand by Theppadungporn Coconut Co., Ltd.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Mae Ploy in Sri Lanka and supplies its green curry paste, red curry paste and tom yum paste to restaurants, hotels and caterers cooking Thai food. A Thai curry usually starts by frying the paste in coconut cream before adding coconut milk, meat or vegetables, fish sauce and palm sugar; tom yum paste is the base of the hot and sour soup of the same name.
mae-ploy.summary: Thai curry pastes made by Theppadungporn Coconut Co. in Thailand: green curry, red curry and tom yum.
mae-ploy.replaces: Mae Ploy is a popular, authentic Thai brand established in 1993, renowned for its high-quality curry pastes, sauces, and coconut milk. Famous for bold flavors, their products (especially pastes) are widely considered a staple for authentic Thai cooking and contain no preservatives.

mahachai.about:
Mahachai is a Thai brand of dried rice noodles. Its Pad Thai Noodles are a flat rice stick made for pad thai, Thailand's best-known stir-fried noodle dish, and are also used in noodle soups and other stir-fries.

The noodles are softened in water, then finished in the wok with the sauce; the pack gives the soaking time. Olive Foods imports and distributes them in Sri Lanka for restaurants, hotels and caterers, alongside Mae Ploy curry pastes, Tiparos fish sauce and Wai Wai rice vermicelli.
mahachai.summary: Thai flat rice-stick noodles for pad thai, noodle soups and stir-fries.

mavees.about:
Mavee's is a brand of Mavee Foods, a bakery and food-service ingredients company in Hyderabad, India. Its range includes whip toppings, cooking cream, gels and glazes, and cake-decorating products.

Olive Foods imports and distributes three Mavee's creams in Sri Lanka: Premium Cooking Cream for sauces, soups, pasta and gravies, and two sweetened whipping creams, Smooth and Silver, for cake decoration, piping, fillings and desserts. Bakeries, pastry kitchens, cafés and hotels buy them for cakes, desserts and cream sauces.
mavees.summary: Cooking cream and sweetened whipping creams from Mavee Foods in Hyderabad, India.

royal-arm.about:
Royal Arm is a brand of Royal Techno Foodstuff Trading LLC, a food trading company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Its range covers sauces, canned goods, olives and oils, vinegars, honey and other pantry staples.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Royal Arm in Sri Lanka, supplying hotels, restaurants, caterers and retailers with pitted and whole black olives, sliced mushrooms, extra virgin olive oil, olive pomace oil and blended sesame oil, honey, apple cider, balsamic and white vinegar, and sauces including light and sweet soy, hoisin, mint sauce and mayonnaise.
royal-arm.summary: Olives, oils, vinegars, honey and sauces from Royal Techno Foodstuff Trading in Dubai, UAE.
royal-arm.replaces: Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Dubai, Royal Techno Foodstuff Trading LLC has established itself as a prominent and trusted name in the food trading sector across the United Arab Emirates and beyond. With a reputation built on excellence, integrity, and reliability, we have rapidly expanded our footprint in local and international markets.

tabasco.about:
Tabasco is the pepper sauce made by McIlhenny Company on Avery Island, Louisiana, USA, which dates its original recipe to 1868. Original Red Sauce has three ingredients: red peppers, distilled vinegar and salt, and the pepper mash is aged before bottling.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Tabasco pepper sauce in 60 ml bottles in Sri Lanka for restaurants, bars, cafés and hotels, where a few drops season eggs, pizza, seafood, marinades, dressings and Bloody Marys.
tabasco.summary: The pepper sauce made by McIlhenny Company on Avery Island, Louisiana, from a recipe dated to 1868.
tabasco.replaces: Tabasco sauce is a famous American brand of hot sauce created in 1868 by Edmund McIlhenny on Avery Island, Louisiana. Made from tabasco peppers, vinegar, and salt, the mash is aged in oak barrels for up to three years. It is known for its versatile, sharp heat and is sold in over 195 countries.

tiparos.about:
Tiparos is a Thai fish sauce made by Tang Sang Hah Co., Ltd., a long-established fish sauce maker in Thailand.

Fish sauce (nam pla) is made by fermenting fish with salt and is the main salty seasoning of Thai cooking. Olive Foods imports and distributes Tiparos fish sauce in Sri Lanka for restaurants, hotels and caterers, for Thai curries, stir-fries, soups such as tom yum, salads and dipping sauces.
tiparos.summary: Thai fish sauce made by Tang Sang Hah Co., Ltd., the seasoning behind Thai curries, soups and dips.
tiparos.replaces: Tiparos is a Thai fish sauce condiment brand under the Tang Sang Hah Company, established in Chonburi Province in 1919.

wai-wai.about:
Wai Wai is a Thai noodle brand. Its rice vermicelli is a thin dried rice noodle that softens in hot water.

Olive Foods imports and distributes Wai Wai rice vermicelli in Sri Lanka for restaurants, hotels and caterers, who use it for stir-fries, noodle soups, fresh spring rolls and noodle salads; the pack gives the soaking time.
wai-wai.summary: Thai rice vermicelli for stir-fries, noodle soups, fresh spring rolls and noodle salads.
wai-wai.replaces: WaiWai Rice Vermicelli Noodles are crafted with premium rice flour to deliver a soft, smooth texture that stays firm, even after cooking.

generic.about:
Alongside the brands it imports, Olive Foods supplies everyday kitchen staples listed under its own name rather than a separate brand: nuts, seeds and dried fruit; frozen beef, lamb, mutton and duck; dried herbs and spices; Japanese ingredients such as panko, mirin, tempura flour and sushi nori; sauces and stock powder; pastry and baking ingredients; flour and cooking oil; and packaging such as foil containers, paper cups, cake cups, baking paper and food-handling gloves.

They come with the same service as the imported brands: trade pricing by quote, warehousing in Colombo, cold chain for frozen lines and delivery across Sri Lanka.
generic.summary: Everyday kitchen staples from Olive Foods: nuts, frozen meat, herbs, Japanese ingredients, sauces, baking supplies and packaging.
